newsitem.title: USA: Thorn Apple closes plant, sees exports up.
newsitem.headline: Thorn Apple closes plant, sees exports up.

text.p: Thorn Apple Valley Inc said Thursday it plans to close its processed meats facility in Iowa and has taken a $5 million pre-tax restructuring charge against fiscal 1997 results related to the move.

The company said also that it expects to double export sales over the next year by continuing to build market share, especially in Russia, where it opened a Moscow office during the fourth quarter, and in Mexico, the Caribbean and South Korea, where it said its Corn King brand is the number one selling hot dog.
The company said recent government hog reports show that hog supplies should be increasing within the next year and that the hog raising industry may begin to stabilize.

The processed meat and poultry products producer said its performance should dramatically and consistently improve if it is able to achieve its goal of increasing volumes in its Processed Meats Division relative to its fresh pork business.

The company said it is improving manufacturing costs as a result of investments in modern, strategically located facilities, and said it is focusing on expanding volumes through product innovation and improved performance of its sales force. "Although we expect there still to be bumps in the road ahead, we believe the future is bright for Thorn Apple Valley," the company said.
